feeds.title: State Of The Arts » Music
feeds.description: Read the latest news and updates from the music industry. State of the Arts has been taking you on location with the most creative people in New Jersey and beyond since 1981. We visit New Jersey's best performance spaces - from little-known jazz clubs to outdoor festivals to the state's exceptional professional theaters.

feeds.title: Rockin' The 'Burbs
feeds.description: Established in 2013, ROCKIN' THE 'BURBS is an independent online music publication based out of Central New Jersey. We cover live music events occurring throughout the Jersey tri-state, especially for indie, up-and-coming, and local DIY artists. We also feature occasional artist interviews, giveaways, and more.

feeds.title: New Jersey Digest » Music
feeds.description: Read the latest news and events from the music industry. The New Jersey Digest has chronicled daily life in the Garden State for over 10 years. Our quarterly publication is a staple in the community and features engaging, original coverage of restaurants, design, real estate, travel, art, culture, and more.

feeds.title: Record Crates United Blog
feeds.description: Since 2012, Keith Hadad's Record Crates United has been a home for wayward music. Artists and sounds from the past and present that may have or at least deserve to have a cult following will have their time here. Adventurous music for adventurous listeners.

feeds.title: NJArts.net » Music
feeds.description: We cover all forms of art including music throughout New Jersey. NJArts.net covers all forms of art throughout New Jersey. It was created in 2014 by Jay Lustig, a journalist who has been covering the arts in New Jersey for 37 years and was previously the Arts and Entertainment Editor for the state's largest daily newspaper, The Star-Ledger.

feeds.title: Gapplegate Classical-Modern Music Review
feeds.description: Modern classical and avant garde concert music of the 20th and 21st centuries forms the primary focus of this blog. It is hoped that through the discussions a picture will emerge of modern music, its heritage, and what it means for us. All styles of relevance will be addressed from Late-Romantic and Neo-Romantic through High-Modern, Avant Garde, and Post-Modern styles.

feeds.title: New Jersey Jazz Society
feeds.description: The New Jersey Jazz Society (NJJS) is a non-profit organization of business and professional people, musicians, teachers, students, and listeners working together for the purpose of advancing jazz music. We are dedicated to the performance, promotion, and preservation of jazz.

feeds.title: The Aquarian
feeds.description: The Aquarian is 50 years old weekly for rock music. It publishes news, reviews, articles, interviews, and more about the rock music of the state of New Jersey.

feeds.title: THE MIC MAG
feeds.description: The Music Insight Column (The MIC), is a music blog designed to discuss music and celebrate emerging artists. Here, you'll find interviews, articles, and curated playlists!

feeds.title: Blood Makes Noise
feeds.description: Reviews - Blog for Blood Makes Noise, a marketing / publicity from Newark

feeds.title: Jersey Watch Blog
feeds.description: Jersey Watch Blog is an NJ-based blog made for independent artists & creatives to showcase their craft. We care about the Indies, and we do it for the Indies. Created by award-nominated company Cutty TV LLC

feeds.title: The Jersey Sound
feeds.description: Get the latest and greatest New Jersey music news! Stay updated on the most exciting and important happenings in the local music scene.

feeds.title: New Jersey Monthly » Music
feeds.description: Stay up to date on the NJ music scene with our entertainment coverage. New Jersey Monthly was founded more than 40 years ago with the express purpose of destroying the myth that New Jersey is a mere pass-through, a featureless suburb of two metropolitan behemoths. The magazine has fulfilled its promise of incisive and illuminating reporting on the issues, the people, and the places that give New Jersey a unique and colorful identity of its own.

feeds.title: Rock Out Loud News
feeds.description: Read articles from Rock Out Loud about the topics that interest you. You'll get tips & tricks from our music school that will help make you a better musician. At Rock Out Loud we want you to enjoy learning and practicing, which is why we show you how to play the music you like, and get you on stage, playing with others who love music just as much as you do!

feeds.title: New Jersey Bangerz
feeds.description: New Jersey Bangerz is NY based music blog covering what's REALLY bangin! We have a mission of empowering local artists & events while still covering mainstream news and bringing America 1 step closer to you. Stay updated on New Jersey's hipop music.

feeds.title: Mad Indie Media Blog
feeds.description: Mad Indie Media is a music collective dedicated to bringing you top-notch music, art, and culture. We promote independent and unsigned artists, labels, podcasts, product services, and more! We report on international independent music, events, and culture with a focus on the North East United States.

feeds.title: MusicWill Blog
feeds.description: Transforming Lives By Transforming Music Education

feeds.title: Rockit Academy Blog
feeds.description: The Rockit Live Foundation is a nonprofit organization. Our mission is to help develop, nurture, and inspire young musicians to reach their full artistic potential through live music education offered at Brookdale Community College. If you have a love for music & aspiring to become a musician or singer, the blogs from Rockit Academy will provide you with the required thrust to meet your goals.

feeds.title: NJ Indy » Music
feeds.description: We provide independent coverage of New Jersey music, news, arts, culture, food, recreation, events, and more. NJ INDY was born out to depict the state of New Jersey in a real sense and to break the stereotype that has formed around it. Our weekly issues publish narrative storytelling and reporting of issues, trends, makers, and events ignored or bungled by the traditional media, often with a touch of irreverence.
